scope: actual retro worker or bounded experimental DMG interpreter, source/content rights asserted by operator

curriculum.later_runs: source-replay-grounded UCB priority; novelty, counterfactual disagreement, revisit uncertainty, replay cost
curriculum.rare_actions: use evidence of least-observed finite control
curriculum.convergence: 10 sequential runs without new coarse visual state AND Q-value motion above 1e-6; not universal proof of no further learnability
curriculum.boomerang: seeded reshuffled reparse intervals and historical reservoir

cross_core.report_diff: per-feature absolute sensor differences, exact frame digest agreements, measured reward deltas, per-core repeat stability

actual_neural_optimizer.algorithm: deterministic two hidden layer tanh MLP, minibatch AdamW
actual_neural_optimizer.objective: one-step source-measured numeric telemetry delta and reward
actual_neural_optimizer.features: all actual available observation channels and action one hot
actual_neural_optimizer.episode_holdout: SHA256-seeded trace-group disjoint holdout; no validation gradients or normalization leakage
actual_neural_optimizer.receipt_validation: reconstitute policy+evidence SHA256 report; verify every committed episode/trace/sequence and rights assertion
actual_neural_optimizer.requirement_for_success: independent local executable run on rights-cleared real ROMs and non-degenerate heldout improvement

limitations: No new native core compiled or ABI-verified by this PR
No real ROM replay or profile/e2e completion proved
Original in-process DMG runtime remains experimental
Native libretro requires approved external binaries and sandbox
Source-rights assertion is not third-party independent legal clearance
No game-event semantic classifier, joystick skill mastery, audiovisual cinematic labels, realtime cross-platform debugger, production LLM weight update or capability promotion has been verified
